action_schema.description: Valid actions; any parse error, schema violation, or missing required field = parse failure

gbnf_grammar:
root ::= ws "{" ws "\"action\"" ws ":" ws action ws "," ws field ws "}" ws
ws ::= [ \t\n]*
action ::= "\"click\"" | "\"answer\""
field ::= "\"selector\"" ws ":" ws string | "\"text\"" ws ":" ws string
string ::= "\"" strchars "\""
strchars ::= strchar strchars | strchar
strchar ::= [^"\\] | "\\" (["\\/bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F] [0-9a-fA-F] [0-9a-fA-F] [0-9a-fA-F])

positive_control.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid JSON matching action schema

prompts.system: You are a web agent. Reply ONLY with one JSON object per turn, no prose. Actions available: {"action":"click","selector":"<id>"} or {"action":"answer","text":"<code>"}. Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.

source: frozen prereg.md sections 3-6 and spec.json measurement_validity; constructed before any outcome-bearing measurement
